reviewer: Codex native artwork and production-player review

identity.evidence: All three unique native poses retain the canonical faceless white-grey athlete, trainers and qualitative muscle shading. Delivery WebP pixels equal those reviewed PNGs exactly.

camera.evidence: Fixed 1024x1536 scene, identical camera and canvas. Full hands and shoes are visible in all poses; no per-frame crop or resize.

anatomy.evidence: Native review of hang, partial raise and horizontal endpoint: two arms, two legs, consistent body proportions, straight arms and legs, neutral head/trunk. Apparent leg foreshortening is consistent with the fixed three-quarter view.

equipment.evidence: The same rigid bar and posts remain in all frames. Two closed grips stay attached; no extra bar, detached weight or apparatus change.

contact.evidence: Four named grip/bar-joint patches have zero best-fit integer translation. PNG and lossless WebP RGB pixels match, preserving those measurements. Shading differs between generated poses; zero translation does not imply identical anatomy.

physics.evidence: Both legs rise from below the hips to approximately hip height and return under control. Arms and trunk remain still; no bent-knee substitution, backward kick or visible swing.

muscles.evidence: Purple rectus abdominis and pale obliques stay consistent. The on-screen key describes visible shading; deep hip flexors are not painted through the body.

cueAgreement.evidence: The six production cues describe the exact straight-leg variation and each fits the seven-word dwell budget. Partial raise makes no unsupported joint-angle claim. Return cue explicitly avoids swinging back.

sequenceAndLoop.evidence: Production ExerciseRigDemo routes leg-raise to the six delivered WebPs with exact registered cues. All six frames were inspected in order; autoplay crosses 6-to-1 using byte-identical endpoint files. Displayed endpoint comparison allows only measured compositor rounding (pixelmatch threshold 0.02, zero differing pixels, antialiasing included). Peak frame 4 intentionally holds 3. Reduced motion remains still and permits stepping.

mobileLight.evidence: Actual production frames and card image inspected at 393x852 in light mode. All native WebPs load at 1024x1536; hands, shoes and equipment remain visible. Captions and seven-word cues are legible, no horizontal overflow, no page errors. Card thumbnail has a transparent background and preserves the raised-leg pose.

mobileDark.evidence: Actual production frames and card image inspected at 393x852 in dark mode. All native WebPs load at 1024x1536; hands, shoes and equipment remain visible. Captions and seven-word cues are legible, no horizontal overflow, no page errors. Card thumbnail has a transparent background and preserves the raised-leg pose.
